#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os,json,subprocess,pathlib,datetime,urllib.request,urllib.error
root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
url=json.load(open(root.parent/'mcp.json'))['mcpServers']['arithmetic']['url']
cli=['npx','--yes','@mcpjam/cli','--no-telemetry']
token=[REDACTED]'MCP_SERVER_TOKEN']
checks=[('positive',{'a':2,'b':3},5),('negative',{'a':-7,'b':2},-5),('decimal',{'a':1.25,'b':2.5},3.75),('zero',{'a':0,'b':0},0),('missing',{'a':2},None),('wrong-type',{'a':'2','b':3},None),('extra-property',{'a':2,'b':3,'c':4},None)]
summary=[]
for name,args,expected in checks:
 p=subprocess.run(cli+['tools','call','--url',url,'--access-token',token,'--tool-name','add','--tool-args',json.dumps(args),'--validate-response'],capture_output=True,text=True)
 stdout=p.stdout.replace(token,'[REDACTED]'); stderr=p.stderr.replace(token,'[REDACTED]')
 (root/(name+'.json')).write_text(stdout);(root/(name+'.stderr')).write_text(stderr)
 try:
  data=json.loads(stdout)
  if expected is None: passed=bool(data.get('isError') or data.get('error') or p.returncode)
  else: passed=data.get('structuredContent',{}).get('sum')==expected and not data.get('isError') and p.returncode==0
 except Exception: passed=False
 summary.append({'name':name,'arguments':args,'expected':expected if expected is not None else 'reject invalid input','passed':passed,'exitCode':p.returncode})
(root/'tool-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token,'Accept':'text/event-stream'})
try: response=urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=5)
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: response=e
(root/'get-response.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status':response.status,'headers':dict(response.headers),'body':response.read().decode()},indent=2)+'\n')
PY
python3 /workspace/validation/validate.py
